notes.title: Update #6
notes.content:
Hello guys,

We have been reading your feedback and reported issues and this first update solves the following issues:

- Solved the hotspots interaction bug on the investigation scene
- Random crashes during shootout scenes solved
- Japanese localization bug properly displayed
- The white square cursor bug is now solved
- Graphical and minor bug fixes

PS: Mac version will be here shortly!

notes.title: Update #5: Ukrainian, Polish and improvements
notes.content:
Along with this second episode, an update of the first episode ‘The End of Peace’ is also released, bringing:

- Polish localization added.
- Ukrainian localization added.
- Performance improvement due to graphics optimizations.
- Added a checkpoint after solving the investigation in the 11th Scene.
- Global revision over all languages.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update #4: China, Hungary and Turkey comes to play!
notes.content:
Dear players!

· A new update arrives thanks to some friends around europe helping us to bring Blues and Bullets to other languages:
     - Hungarian localization
     - Turkish localization
     - Chinese localization
   
· Hostpots index: useful to understand how many interactions we missed in previous scenes.

· Graphic optimizations and minor bug fixes, specially shader issues generating problems with higher resolutions.

· Reduction of the game's size on disc.

· Minor bug fixes.

We are still working to improve the performance and overall experience, so please, keep posting on the forum so we can know more about what to tackle as soon as we can.

Soon we'll be back, stay tuned!

notes.title: Update #3: Some Blues in FLAC format
notes.content:
Hello people!

This update will add in the game folder '.../Original Soundtrack/FLAC' the OST in this sweet format for the owners of the Untouchable edition or those who get the Soundtrack DLC.

Furthermore, we want to let you know about the next update, coming up before the end of October.
Update #4 will include some improvements that some users have been demanding, like:
- Hostpots index: useful to understand how many interactions we missed in previous scenes, for achievement hunters ;)
- Resource optimization
- A reduction of the game's size on disc
- More languages: Turkish, Hungarian and Chinese.
- Minor bug fixes

Stay tuned and thanks for your patience, feedback and support!

notes.title: Update #2: Blues and Languages
notes.content:
Hello guys, we are celebrating the one month anniversary of the first episode release by adding more languages to the game:

- Russian
- Czech
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Japanese

Other improvements are on the way and the Episode 2 is going great, with more mysteries to investigate, bullets to spend and plot twists to experience.

Stay tuned or you may end up like Boccherini!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Solved bugs:
- Fixed the progress bar in the 'Conscientious' achievement.
- Fixed a rare bug related to controller where players can move but can't interact.
- Solved an issue with the HUD in credits.

Features:
- The game use the language selected in Steam game parameters.
- You can manually disable the gamepad HUD and use the standard keyboard HUD.
- Various optimizations

We want to thank the community for your help, support and patience. You rock guys!
